paragraphs.text: The Mississippi Access to Justice Commission lists a free Pontotoc County legal clinic for 12:30 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 12, at the Pontotoc County Chancery Building, 34 South Liberty Street.

Online registration is marked closed as of Wednesday morning, Nov. 4. People interested in attending should contact the commission at 601-974-0470 to check availability before making plans. The organizer accepts calls and texts at that number.
The clinic description says volunteer attorneys provide guidance for low-income people who are representing themselves in court because they cannot afford to hire a lawyer.

Listed topics include child support, custody, divorce, name changes and expungements. The notice also gives document requirements that vary by issue. Readers can review the full event page and confirm details with the commission.
